SELECT cs.id AS session_id, ct.name AS session_name, ct.category AS session_category, ct.description AS session_description, ct.cover_image AS session_cover_image, ct.duration_minutes AS session_duration_minutes, cs.capacity AS session_capacity, cs.booked_count AS session_booked_count, (cs.capacity - cs.booked_count) AS session_remaining_seats, cs.price AS session_price, ct.difficulty AS session_difficulty, cs.start_time AS session_start_time, cs.end_time AS session_end_time, cs.status AS session_status, c.id AS coach_id, c.name AS coach_name, c.avatar AS coach_avatar, v.id AS venue_id, v.name AS venue_name, v.address AS venue_address FROM course_sessions cs LEFT JOIN course_templates ct ON cs.template_id = ct.id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON cs.coach_id = c.id LEFT JOIN venues v ON cs.venue_id = v.id WHERE cs.deleted = 0
AND ( ct.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ct.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ct.category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY cs.start_time ASC
